parsed.rationale: The Methodology section (p. 732) reports quantitative analysis of potable-water and sewerage access and qualitative content analysis of 17 Habitat III National Reports for governance arrangements and national policies. Table 2 and its discussion (pp. 737-739) report country-level proportions lacking piped water and sewerage connections, while the Risk governance section (pp. 741-742) empirically analyzes relevant policies, legislation, decentralization, and institutional arrangements. The population, governance exposure, service-access outcomes, and mixed-methods document-analysis design are therefore identifiable.
